Q.6  Compare a linear spring 𝑓1 (with constant 𝑘1) and a nonlinear spring
      𝑓2 = 𝑘2𝑥³ (with constant 𝑘2) both with coefficient value 10 (𝑘1 =
     10 𝑁/𝑚, 𝑘2 = 10 𝑁/𝑚³). At a displacement of 𝑥 = 2 m, what is the
       ratio of the nonlinear spring force to the linear spring force?

     Answer: 4

     Answer: 4

      Linear force, 𝑓1 = 𝑘1. 𝑥= 10 × 2 = 20 𝑁.
     Nonlinear force, 𝑓2 = 𝑘2. 𝑥³ = 10 × 2³ = 10 × 8 = 80 𝑁.

               𝑓2   80      Ratio,  =  = 4.
               𝑓1   20
